essence: Particular fancy arisen; purified trace holding.
Fashioned knower undistracted stays in thought-free self.
Behold one known made world; else trifling unreal.

sections.SUMMARY: Narrowed action-mind gained called bound soul; willed blessed Bhairava measured. Narrow-functioned follows power; stations gained from contracted state. Ownmost creation teeming fancy arisen Śaiva; purified trace holding. Such-fashioned knower stays undistracted at limitation-feast in thought-free self. Child bidden behold nondual known-made world; else dismissed trifling. Unothered way principle; self-way so-called.

rasa.dominant: vīra of called bound; vīra of followed stations; adbhuta of teeming imagination; śānta of feast-abiding; vātsalya-vīra of bidden beholding; vīra of unothered means
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at willed-measured; utsāha at gained stations; vismaya at this-and-that fancied; śama at undistracted staying; vātsalyotsāha at child-shown one; utsāha at self-way called
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: narrowed, called, measured. Calling relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: narrowed, following, gained. Following relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: particular, teeming, holding. Imagining relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: fashioned, feasted, undistracted. Abiding relished. The sthāyibhāva is tender exultation: child bidden, one shown, else dismissed. Beholding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: way asked, unothered, called. Asking relished.
